children.name: frequency
children.helperInfo: Description: Positive integer of optical channel laser frequency. This attribute work for both input and output laser Value type: positive integer Value range: 186050000…196100000 Units: MHz Granularity: 1 Default value: 193100000

children.name: target-output-power
children.helperInfo: Description: The target output laser optical power of identifier optical channel. Value type: 2-digit decimal Value range: -10.00...5.00 Units: dBm Granularity: 0.01 Default value: -3

children.name: operational-mode
children.helperInfo: Description: The specified operational mode index of optical channel. This attribute values and attribute operational-mode-name values are one-to-one correspondence, either one configuration will change the optical channel operational mode.

children.name: operational-mode-name
children.helperInfo: Description: The specified operational mode name of optical channel. This attribute values and attribute operational-mode-index values are one-to-one correspondence, either one configuration will change the optical channel operational mode. Available Value - "ZR400-16QAM-60G-OFEC": operational mode 400G 16QAM OpenZR+ - "ZR400-16QAMSS-60G-OFEC": operational mode 400G 16QAM OpenZR+ (SS) - "ZR300-8QAM-60G-OFEC": operational mode 300G 8QAM Open ZR+ - "ZR200-QPSK- 60G-OFEC": operational mode 200G QPSK Open ZR+ - "ZR200-QPSKSS-60G-OFEC": operational mode 200G QPSK Open ZR+ (SS) - "ZR100-QPSK-30G-OFEC": operational mode 100G QPSK Open ZR+ - "100G-dQPSK-30G-SCFEC": operational mode 100G QPSK SC FEC - "200G-16QAM-32G-SDFEC": operational mode 200G 16QAM SD FEC - "200G-QPSK-64G-SDFEC": operational mode 200G QPSK SD FEC - "200G-16QAMPS-41G-SDFEC": operational mode 200G 16QAMPS SD FEC - "1200G-64QAMPS-138G-SDFEC": operational mode 1200G 64QAMPS SD FEC - "400G-16QAMPS-109P8G-SDFEC": operational mode 400G 16QAMPS SD FEC - "600G-16QAMPS-107P7G-SDFEC": operational mode 600G 16QAMPS SD FEC - "800G-16QAMPS-138G-SDFEC": operational mode 4800G 16QAMPS SD FEC Default value: ZR400-16QAMSS-60G-OFEC This attribute operation needs service-affection confirmation

children.name: laser
children.helperInfo: Description: The switch of transceiver output laser of identifier optical channel. Linkage with the attribute laser of port Available Value - enabled: enable the Tx laser of transceiver - disabled: disable the Tx laser of transceiver default mode: “enabled”

children.name: loopback
children.helperInfo: Description: The switch of signal’s loopback mode Available Value - “facility”: enable the loopback which directs traffic normally transmitted on the port back to the device as if received on the same port from an external source. - “terminal”: enable the loopback which directs traffic received from an external source on the port back out the transmit side of the same port. - “none”: no loopback is applied default mode: “none”

children.name: test-signal
children.helperInfo: Description: The switch of generating a pseudo random bit stream (PRBS) which can be used during testing on current instance Possibility Value: - “enabled”: enable the test signal. - “disabled”: disabled the test signal. default mode: “disabled”

children.name: test-monitor
children.helperInfo: Description: The switch of monitor a pseudo random bit stream (PRBS) which can be used during testing on current instance Available Value - “enabled”: Enable the test monitor - “disabled”: Disabled the test monitor. default mode: “disabled”

children.name: test-monitor-time
children.helperInfo: Description: The planned executed time for next turn test monitor. 0 means the test will not stop monitor until operator disable it manually. Value type: integer Value range: 0…604800 Granularity: 1 Units: seconds Default value: 0

children.name: test-signal-status
children.helperInfo: Description: The result of pseudo random bit stream (PRBS) testing on current instance Possibility Value: - “in-sync”: the test signal sync up successes. - “out-of-sync”: the test signal sync up failed or test signal disabled. - “errored”: ”: the test signal is synchronized with error counting. - “unmonitored“: Do not monitor the test signal

children.name: test-monitor-time-countdown
children.helperInfo: Description: The countdown to test monitor time completed. Possibility Output Value: - "untimed": The test monitor without planned execution time. - Value type: integer - Units : seconds

children.name: test-total-received-bits
children.helperInfo: Description: The total bits of the received test signal. Value type: integer

children.name: test-bit-errors
children.helperInfo: Description: The bit errors of the received test signal. Value type: integer

children.name: test-bit-error-ratio
children.helperInfo: Description: The bit error ratio of the received test signal. Value type: 17-digit decimal

children.name: test-out-of-sync-seconds
children.helperInfo: Description: The seconds of the received out of sync test signal. Value type: integer

children.name: bit-rate
children.helperInfo: Description: Rounded bit rate of the tributary signal delivered by the optical channel associated to the specific operational mode Units: Gbps

children.name: bandwidth
children.helperInfo: Description: The signal bandwidth level after FEC Value type: positive integer Units: GHz

children.name: baud-rate
children.helperInfo: Description: The symbol baud rate of identifier optical channel Value type: 2-digit decimal Units: GBd

children.name: bits-per-symbol
children.helperInfo: Description: The bits of per symbol coding Value type: 2-digit decimal Units: bits/symbol

children.name: modulation-type
children.helperInfo: Description: The coherent modulation format of signal Possibility Value: - QPSK - 8QAM - 16QAM - 64QAM - DP-dQPSK

children.name: fec-mode
children.helperInfo: Description: Forward Error Correction code type of optical channel Value type: string

children.name: tx-spectral-shaping
children.helperInfo: Description: The tx direction spectral shaping working mode Possibility Value: • “on”: enable the spectral shaping • “off”: disable the spectral shaping

children.name: cd-range-min
children.helperInfo: Description: The minimum threshold of CD scan range Value type: negative integer Range: -2147483648 ... 0 Units: ps/nm

children.name: cd-range-max
children.helperInfo: Description: The maximum threshold of CD scan range Value type: positive integer Range: 0 ... 2147483647 Units: ps/nm

children.name: filter-roll-off
children.helperInfo: Description: The roll off factor of transmitter filter Value type: 1-digit decimal

children.name: fec-uncorrectable-blocks
children.helperInfo: Description: Counter of optical channel’s receiver signal uncorrected blocks Value type: positive integer Units: blocks

children.name: output-power
children.helperInfo: Description: Statistics state of optical channel transferred signal optical power, include instant, avg, min, max value Value type: 2-digit decimal Units: dBm

children.name: total-input-power

children.name: provisioned-channel-input-power
children.helperInfo: Description: Statistics state of optical channel received signal channel power, include instant, avg, min, max value Value type: 2-digit decimal Units: dBm

children.name: osnr
children.helperInfo: Description: Statistics state of optical channel received signal channel optical signal noise ratio, include instant, avg, min, max value Value type: 2-digit decimal Units: dB

children.name: chromatic-dispersion
children.helperInfo: Description: Statistics state of optical channel received signal chromatic dispersion, include instant, avg, min, max value Value type: positive integer Units: ps/nm

children.name: polarization-mode-dispersion
children.helperInfo: Description: Statistics state of optical channel received signal polarization mode dispersion, include instant, avg, min, max value Value type: 2-digit decimal Units: ps

children.name: second-order-polarization-mode-dispersion
children.helperInfo: Description: Statistics state of optical channel received signal second order polarization mode dispersion, include instant, avg, min, max value Value type: 2-digit decimal Units: ps^2

children.name: polarization-dependent-loss
children.helperInfo: Description: Statistics state of optical channel received signal polarization dependent loss, include instant, avg, min, max value Value type: 2-digit decimal Units: dB

children.name: state-of-polarization
children.helperInfo: Description: Statistics state of optical channel received signal state of polarization change rate, include instant, avg, min, max value Value type: 2-digit decimal Units: rad/s

children.name: differential-group-delay
children.helperInfo: Description: Statistics state of optical channel differential group delay, include instant, avg, min, max value Value type: 2-digit decimal Units: ps

children.name: pre-fec-ber
children.helperInfo: Description: Statistics state of optical channel received signal bit error rate before forward error correction, include instant, avg, min, max value Value type: 2-digit decimal scientific notation: x.xxE±yy

children.name: post-fec-ber
children.helperInfo: Description: Statistics state of optical channel received signal bit error rate after forward error correction, include instant, avg, min, max value Value type: 2-digit decimal scientific notation: x.xxE±yy

children.name: esnr
children.helperInfo: Description: Statistics state of optical channel signal noise ratio, include instant, avg, min, max value Value type: 2-digit decimal Units: dB

children.name: q-value
children.helperInfo: Description: Statistics state of optical channel quality factor, include instant, avg, min, max value Value type: 2-digit decimal Units: dB

children.helperInfo: Description: Statistics state of optical channel quality factor margin, units dB, include instant, avg, min, max value Value type: 2-digit decimal Units: dB
